svg.title: JSW WhatsApp Field Console hero banner
svg.desc: A light hero banner with sky background, headline JSW WhatsApp Field Console, a subtitle, four feature icons, an app mockup card on the right, and a landscape illustration of mountains, trees and grass along the bottom

text.style: fill:rgb(11, 42, 74);stroke:none;color:rgb(11, 11, 11);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;font-size:32px;font-weight:700;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto
